item.title: From Trinidad to Queens: Nicki Minaj’s immigration story, Trump ties and gold card
item.description: Nicki Minaj, the Trinidad-born rapper who rose to fame repping Queens, New York, is drawing renewed attention for her growing public support of President Donald Trump.

item.title: Man attempts to break Luigi Mangione out of prison by posing as FBI agent: authorities
item.description: A man claiming to be an FBI agent appeared at a federal jail on Wednesday night and told officers he had a court order to release Luigi Mangione, the Associated Press reported through authorities.

item.title: Frigid temps continue for NYC this week; chances for snow decrease
item.description: New Yorkers can expect recent frigid temperatures to continue, but the chance for snow seems to be decreasing.

item.title: Dangerous cold grips New York, New Jersey and Connecticut this weekend as snow threat fades
item.description: New York, New Jersey and Connecticut face another bitterly cold weekend, with wind chills well below zero and limited snow chances.

item.title: Don Lemon taken into custody in Los Angeles in connection with Minnesota church protest: Reports
item.description: Former CNN anchor Don Lemon was taken into custody Friday following a protest inside a Minnesota church, according to reporting from The New York Times.

item.title: Fallen cables from elevated J line damage parked cars, slow subway service in Brooklyn
item.description: Fallen communication cables from elevated J line tracks blocked a Brooklyn street Friday morning, prompting an FDNY response and slowing subway service, according to the MTA.

item.title: Judge rules federal prosecutors can’t seek death penalty against Luigi Mangione
item.description: A federal judge in New York dismissed a federal murder charge against Luigi Mangione on Friday, ruling prosecutors cannot seek the death penalty in the case tied to the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.

item.title: NJ Transit delays today due to disabled Amtrak train stuck in Hudson River Tunnel
item.description: NJ TRANSIT rail service is facing delays of up to 60 minutes into and out of New York Penn Station after a disabled train in one of the Hudson River Tunnels, officials said.
